newsitem.title: UK: Swiss watchmaker TAG Heuer mulls share flotation.
newsitem.headline: Swiss watchmaker TAG Heuer mulls share flotation.

text.p: Leading Swiss sports watch and chronograph maker TAG Heuer International SA is examining plans for a share flotation.
"Salomon Brothers Inc and SBC Warburg have been appointed to advise TAG Heuer on its options," the company said in a statement on Wednesday.
Sales at TAG Heuer rose 10 percent in 1995 to 380 million Swiss francs ($318 million) and operating income was up 17 percent over the previous year to 77 million.

At present, the company which was founded in 1860, is 15 percent owned by three managers, 43 percent by TAG Finances and 41 percent by Doughty Hanson & Co. -- David Chance London newsroom 44 171 542 5887 ($ = 1.195 Swiss Francs)
